title: Expose ArchMap Next boundary-analysis sample
description: Add a concise demo DSL that exercises Resource communication, nested Container Boundaries, overlapping Overlay Boundaries, derived Crossings, and Overlay Transitions.
completion_criteria: The demo sample selector exposes an ArchMap Next boundary-analysis sample.
The sample uses released DSL terms and requires no authored Crossing records.
Automated tests prove Container Crossings and Overlay Transitions are derived from the sample.
triage_notes: Added the ArchMap Next boundary-crossings sample to the demo selector. The released DSL maps nodes to Resources, nested zones to Container Boundaries, boundaries to Overlay Boundaries, and edges to direct communication. A focused contract proves public-subnet exit/app-subnet enter Crossings plus PCI gained/lost Overlay Transitions without authored Crossing records. Verified 327 tests, typecheck, production builds, and deterministic 120/1000-Resource topology benchmarks.
